description: Interactions client on a plain Gemini API key (no interactions opt-in): today's core translates the request to generateContent; the new core serves Interactions only on native accounts, so no account serves it.

exceptions.reason: Interactions clients are served only by native Interactions accounts (a Gemini key or Vertex account with interactions: true). Today's core translates them onto every other account (here a plain Gemini key, through generateContent); the new core does not carry those translators (about 10k lines in today's core), and the Interactions API's server-side state (previous_interaction_id, agents) cannot be carried to other providers. A request no account serves gets the core's usual error: the last account's unsupported answer, 400.

error.message: this account does not serve the Interactions API (its interactions setting is off)
